(a) System software

Q.3 Write TRUE/FALSE against the following statements.

i. The operating system acts as an interface between the computer hardware and the human user.

ii. Multiprogramming allows the processor to make use of idle time caused by I/O wait.

iii. An operating system controls the execution of applications and acts as an interface between applications and the computer hardware.

iv. In the early computers, the operating systems did not exist.

v. Multi-programming do not provide better utilization of system resources than multiprogramming.

vi. In a time sharing system, when a process is assigned to the CPU for execution, it remains there till its completion.

vii. A process is a dispatchable unit of thread.

viii. A process is directly assigned to the CPU for processing from a block state when the event for which it is waiting happens.

iii. Which one of the following is correct for multiprocessing operating systems?

(a) Used on systems having only one processor

(b) Cannot execute more than one processes at a time

(c) Run on systems which having more than one processors

(d) None of the above

iv. Multiprogramming refers to:

(a) Having several programs in RAM at the same time

(b) Multiprocessing

(c) Writing programs in multiple languages

(d) None of the above

v. The most recently launched operating system of Microsoft is:

(a) Windows 98

(b) Windows 8

(c) DOS

(d) Windows NT

vi. Which of the following is not an operating system?

(a) Linux

(b) MS Word

(c) UNIX

(d) Windows XP Professional

vii. Which type of software enables you to solve specific problems or perform specific tasks?

(a) System software

(b) Operating system

(c) Utility software

(d) Application software

viii. Which type of software controls your application software and manages how your hardware devices work together?

(a) System software

(b) Operating system

(c) Utility software

(d) Application software

ix. A technique in which a process, executing an application, is divided into threads that can run concurrently is called:

(a) Multithreading

(b) Multiprocessing

(c) Batch processing

(d) None of the above

Q.3 Write TRUE/FALSE against the following statements.

i. The operating system acts as an interface between the computer hardware and the human user.

ii. Multiprogramming allows the processor to make use of idle time caused by I/O wait.

iii. An operating system controls the execution of applications and acts as an interface between applications and the computer hardware.

iv. In the early computers, the operating systems did not exist.

v. Multi-programming do not provide better utilization of system resources than multiprogramming.

vi. In a time sharing system, when a process is assigned to the CPU for execution, it remains there till its completion.

vii. A process is a dispatchable unit of thread.

viii. A process is directly assigned to the CPU for processing from a block state when the event for which it is waiting happens.
